sal.basis: Senior Financial Analyst / FP&A, ~8 yrs, Madrid, base salary (bonus excluded): about EUR 50,000 gross a year, i.e. EUR 4,160 a month on a 12-month basis. Recruiter salary guides for Spain (Hays, Michael Page, Robert Walters, 2025 editions, from prior knowledge; not re-verified live because the search budget ran out) put senior financial / FP&A analysts in Madrid at roughly EUR 40-55k and FP&A managers at roughly EUR 55-75k; Barcelona is similar or slightly lower, other cities 10-20% lower. Spanish pay is quoted bruto anual, often split into 14 payments. f = 4,160 / 26,000 = 0.16, so Noura's 26,000 SAR maps to about EUR 50k a year and her 34,000 SAR expectation to about EUR 65k, the entry FP&A-manager band.

rule.en: If you need sponsorship, we skip Spanish jobs that require an existing work permit ("permiso de trabajo") and prioritise employers that hire international talent.
rule.ar: إذا كنت تحتاج إلى كفالة، نتجاوز الوظائف في إسبانيا التي تشترط تصريح عمل ساريًا («permiso de trabajo»)، ونعطي الأولوية لأصحاب العمل الذين يوظّفون كفاءات دولية.
rule.fr: Si vous avez besoin d'un parrainage, nous écartons les offres en Espagne qui exigent un permis de travail en cours de validité (« permiso de trabajo ») et privilégions les employeurs qui recrutent à l'international.

sensitive.notes: Spanish CVs still often carry a photo, but it is not required and multinationals in Madrid and Barcelona increasingly go without, so we allow one but never ask for it. Older Spanish CV templates list date of birth, DNI, nationality and marital status under 'datos personales'; this is fading, and asking for such data in recruitment can be discriminatory: the Workers' Statute (art. 4.2.c and 17) and Law 15/2022 on equal treatment protect sex, age, origin and marital status, and LISOS art. 16.1.c makes requesting personal data in selection processes that leads to discrimination a very serious offence. Right to work is asked instead of nationality. Some portals (e.g. InfoJobs) store date of birth in the candidate profile; we do not ask for it.

privacy.en: Your data is protected under the GDPR and Spain's data protection law (LOPDGDD), overseen by the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD).
privacy.ar: بياناتك محمية بموجب اللائحة العامة لحماية البيانات (GDPR) وقانون حماية البيانات الإسباني (LOPDGDD)، وتحت إشراف الوكالة الإسبانية لحماية البيانات (AEPD).
privacy.fr: Vos données sont protégées par le RGPD et la loi espagnole sur la protection des données (LOPDGDD), sous le contrôle de l'Agence espagnole de protection des données (AEPD).

renewal.en: Your plan renews automatically at the end of each term until you cancel. You can cancel any time in Settings, as easily as you signed up; we email you at least 15 days before a 4- or 12-month plan renews, and you have 14 days to withdraw after purchase.
renewal.ar: تتجدد خطتك تلقائيًا في نهاية كل فترة حتى تلغيها. يمكنك الإلغاء في أي وقت من الإعدادات بالسهولة نفسها التي اشتركت بها، ونرسل لك بريدًا إلكترونيًا قبل 15 يومًا على الأقل من تجديد خطة الأشهر الأربعة أو الاثني عشر شهرًا، ولك حق الانسحاب خلال 14 يومًا من الشراء.
renewal.fr: Votre formule se renouvelle automatiquement à la fin de chaque période jusqu'à résiliation. Vous pouvez résilier à tout moment dans les Paramètres, aussi simplement que lors de votre inscription ; nous vous envoyons un e-mail au moins 15 jours avant le renouvellement d'une formule de 4 ou 12 mois, et vous disposez de 14 jours pour vous rétracter après l'achat.

bio.en: Financial Analyst with 8 years in Madrid. I lead IFRS and Spanish GAAP (PGC) reporting, budgeting and forecasting on SAP across business units, and own the monthly close for a 40-person finance team. My rolling forecasts and Power BI dashboards feed every quarterly business review, and I work in Spanish and English.
bio.ar: محللة مالية بخبرة 8 سنوات في مدريد. أقود إعداد التقارير وفق المعايير الدولية (IFRS) والمخطط المحاسبي العام الإسباني (PGC)، وإعداد الموازنات والتوقعات على نظام SAP عبر وحدات الأعمال، وأتولى الإقفال الشهري لفريق مالي من 40 شخصًا. تُعتمد توقعاتي المتجددة ولوحات Power BI التي أعدّها في كل مراجعة ربع سنوية للأعمال، وأعمل باللغتين الإسبانية والإنجليزية.
bio.fr: Analyste financière forte de 8 ans d'expérience à Madrid. Je pilote le reporting IFRS et selon le plan comptable espagnol (PGC), le budget et les prévisions sous SAP pour plusieurs business units, et je suis responsable de la clôture mensuelle d'une équipe finance de 40 personnes. Mes prévisions glissantes et mes tableaux de bord Power BI alimentent chaque revue trimestrielle, et je travaille en espagnol et en anglais.

culture.notes: Mon-Fri, 40-hour legal maximum; many offices run a 'jornada intensiva' (finishing around 15:00) in July-August and often on Fridays, and hybrid work is common at Madrid and Barcelona multinationals. Salaries are discussed as gross per year (bruto anual), paid monthly at month end, often in 14 payments (two extra payments in June/July and December), so always say whether a figure is in 12 or 14 payments. Notice on resignation (preaviso) is set by the collective agreement or contract (Workers' Statute art. 49.1.d): 15 days is the usual default, and some agreements set 1-2 months for graduate or senior staff. A trial period of up to 6 months applies to graduate-level roles (art. 14). CV: 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, photo common but optional; a short cover letter (carta de presentación) is appreciated but optional on LinkedIn and InfoJobs. Spanish is expected at most employers; English is valued and often required at multinationals; Catalan is an asset in Barcelona and Basque in parts of the Basque public sector. Specialist recruiters (Michael Page, Hays, Robert Walters, Randstad Professional) fill many FP&A roles.
